##### Project general facts

Anantara Sharjah Resort by Arada is a five-star hotel and residences destination set directly on a sandy seafront. A signature gateway inspired by the path of the sun forms the defining architectural feature of the resort, welcoming residents and guests into an oasis of leisure. The building rises above a basement parking level, a ground floor and a two-level podium to twelve residential floors, offering a collection of one- to four-bedroom apartments and penthouses with sweeping sea views.

Residents enjoy direct access to a private beach and a waterfront promenade lined with beachfront restaurants and cafes. A lagoon-style pool, an infinity pool, a children's pool and splash zone, a spa, a fitness centre, a yoga studio and a meditation area support wellness, while beach volleyball, multi-purpose courts, jogging tracks, landscaped gardens and a kids' club add variety. Concierge, butler, babysitting, valet parking and round-the-clock security deliver signature Anantara hospitality.

Residences combine contemporary design with refined coastal character. Floor-to-ceiling windows maximise natural light and open onto generous balconies with uninterrupted views of the sea and the corniche, while premium appliances, stylish worktops and high-quality flooring run throughout. Homes are delivered fully furnished with pieces that reflect the signature style of the Anantara brand, and penthouses feature distinctive layouts and the highest standard of finishes.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Rifa'ah is a coastal district of Sharjah stretching along the Arabian Gulf, close to Al Khan and the Sharjah Corniche. Sandy beaches, waterfront parks and promenades for walking, jogging and cycling give the area a relaxed seaside character, while traditional dhows, heritage sites and local markets reflect the maritime history of the emirate alongside modern cafes, hotels and leisure venues.

Al Khan Beach, Al Mamzar Beach Park and Al Majaz Waterfront are a short drive away, along with Sharjah Aquarium and the Heart of Sharjah heritage district. Al Ittihad Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with Dubai, while Sharjah International Airport and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, and schools, hospitals and shopping centres serve families nearby.

Sharjah offers freehold ownership to international buyers in designated communities, and branded beachfront residences are in very limited supply in the emirate. Five-star branded hospitality, a private beach and a full resort offer appeal to families, holiday home buyers and investors. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai and strong demand for serviced waterfront homes support attractive rental prospects and long-term value.
